data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The single negative review highlights a communication issue but does not allege poor workmanship or fraud. The positive reviews are detailed, span many years, and reference specific scenarios and personnel. The off-topic 'saint' review is a minor anomaly but not a strong fake signal given the overall authentic context. The company's 72-year history and A+ BBB rating support credibility.
fake_signals: One review (Waking-To Kindness) is off-topic and reads like a personal character reference rather than a service review

positive_evidence: Customer mentions comfort in using them for future warranty work due to being local

authentic_signals: Specific project details (15-year roof, leak, 8-person crew, commercial property)
Mix of praise and one specific complaint about communication
data.discrepancy_explanation: No significant discrepancies. Google rating is high and BBB rating is excellent. Lack of reviews on other platforms is not unusual for a local contractor.

reviews.text:
A small roof leak development in my  15 yr roof
I made one call to Big D and I immediately was put on the schedule for a new roof.
The 8 person crew that came to my home was efficient, professional, and extremely hard working. At the end of each day all debris was collected and put in the trailer.  They were very respectful and quiet , if that is possible , while putting on a new roof.
Experience is crucial In this  type of project and Big D did not disappoint.
It was a pleasure to work with everyone. Thank you for an excellent job.
reviews.author: Susan Berger

reviews.text: Professional and trustworthy. A definite great experience. I researched several roofing companies and settled on Big D when a contractor friend recommended them. I’m very happy with my choice. They did all the work they promised and cleaned after themselves.
reviews.author: Liza Kummer

reviews.text: had as great experience with this company. Everything looks great! Thank you!
reviews.author: Cameron

reviews.text: I was referred to Big D Roofing from a member of my church. I’ve been cautious of contractors due to some issues I’ve had in the past. They worked around my busy work schedule to come out and give me a bid. I got a honest appraisal, even came in a bit under the adjusters report. I have a small home and they were finished with job in a day. What made me really feel comfortable with Big D was they are local to DFW, not storm chasing contractors, so if I ever need to call them for warranty work which is 2 years I know they will be here. Based on the banks inspection though I don’t think that will ever happen. If you are looking for honest, professional, & quality work give Big D Roofing a call first.
reviews.author: Mike M

reviews.text: Had a great experience with Arturo at Big D Roofing. Excellent customer service, and dedication. Thank you Arturo for taking the time to meet on your day off and not making us feel rushed or ignorant. We had alot of questions and he helped us to make the best decision. Will be using him again for sure!
reviews.author: Ethan Flores

reviews.text: The owner, Larry, is a secret saint :  He quietly brings food, & at-times a little $, to homeless people who seem to be trying. ( --  in nearby parks, etc, where he  walks his dog daily.  --- always bringing a sack & picking up litter as they go.  ---- He even cleans his dog's teeth, w/ a washcloth. )  Most of all, tho:  He makes sure that his roofing crews & supplies are always only the best.
reviews.author: Waking-To Kindness

reviews.text: Their team is phenomenal. We had a major leak on a commercial property and they came out same day, identified the issue, and were able to fix it quickly. Thank you guys!
reviews.author: Blake Fowler

reviews.text: I called several times to get a roof repair quote and was not called back for about a week. After I spoke with Arturo he said he would send a quote within the week but never sent one. I’m now searching for other companies.
reviews.author: Leslie Kadane
